bridge.cause: EU price increase (net of extra cancellations)

summary.memo:
Net revenue (succeeded payments minus referral payouts) fell 6.0% from $559,534 in Q2 to $525,746 in Q3, even though signups rose 22% and 30-day retention rose from 41% to 52%.

Where the revenue went, in percentage points of Q2 revenue: Plan mix shift -2.4pp (range -4.8 to +0.1); EU price increase -2.0pp (range -3.5 to -0.6); Referral programme -1.3pp (range -1.9 to -0.2); Unexplained -0.4pp (range -3.3 to +2.6).

Onboarding: keep (medium confidence) - 30-day retention is +17.6pp higher in treatment, but no revenue effect is shown yet. Europe price: change (medium confidence) - the increase costs 2.0pp net of extra cancellations. Referral programme: stop (medium confidence) - about 78% of referrals look cannibalised, and in-quarter revenue does not cover the payouts (later payments are not counted).

Caveats: small samples (450 and 549 signups, 87 referrals); ranges are 95% and reflect count noise only; the data is synthetic.

bridge.evidence_query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, plan,
         CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30' THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q3' END q
  FROM workspaces WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-09-30')
SELECT c.q, c.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT c.workspace_id) AS n,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='succeeded' THEN p.amount END),0) AS rev
FROM c LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
  AND p.payment_date BETWEEN CASE c.q WHEN 'Q2' THEN '2025-04-01' ELSE '2025-07-01' END
                         AND CASE c.q WHEN 'Q2' THEN '2025-06-30' ELSE '2025-09-30' END
GROUP BY c.q, c.plan

bridge.cause: EU price increase (net of extra cancellations)
bridge.evidence_query:
SELECT SUM(p.amount - CASE w.plan WHEN 'monthly' THEN 29.0 ELSE 480.0 END) AS u
FROM payments p JOIN workspaces w USING(workspace_id)
WHERE p.status='succeeded' AND w.country IN ('DE','ES','FR','IT','NL') AND p.payment_date BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-09-30';
SELECT CASE WHEN w.country IN ('DE','ES','FR','IT','NL') THEN 'EU' ELSE 'non-EU' END AS grp,
 SUM(s.start_date<'2025-05-01' AND (s.cancel_date IS NULL OR s.cancel_date>='2025-05-01')) AS pre_active,
 SUM(s.start_date<'2025-05-01' AND s.cancel_date BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-06-30') AS pre_cancel,
 SUM(s.start_date<'2025-08-01' AND (s.cancel_date IS NULL OR s.cancel_date>='2025-08-01')) AS post_active,
 SUM(s.start_date<'2025-08-01' AND s.cancel_date BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-09-30') AS post_cancel
FROM subscriptions s JOIN workspaces w USING(workspace_id)
WHERE s.plan='monthly' GROUP BY grp;
SELECT CASE WHEN w.country IN ('DE','ES','FR','IT','NL') THEN 'EU' ELSE 'non-EU' END AS grp,
 SUM(kind='renewed') AS renewed, SUM(kind='not_renewed') AS not_renewed FROM (
  SELECT w.workspace_id, 'renewed' AS kind FROM payments p JOIN workspaces w USING(workspace_id)
   WHERE w.plan='annual' AND p.payment_date BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-09-30' AND p.payment_date > w.signup_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.workspace_id, 'not_renewed' FROM subscriptions s JOIN workspaces w USING(workspace_id)
   WHERE s.plan='annual' AND s.cancel_date BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-09-30') x
 JOIN workspaces w USING(workspace_id) GROUP BY grp

SELECT
 SUM(signup_date < '2025-09-01') AS pre_total,
 SUM(signup_date >= '2025-09-01') AS post_total,
 SUM(signup_date >= '2025-09-01' AND workspace_id IN (SELECT referred_workspace_id FROM referrals)) AS post_referred,
 SUM(signup_date >= '2025-09-01' AND workspace_id NOT IN (SELECT referred_workspace_id FROM referrals)) AS post_organic,
 CAST(julianday('2025-09-01')-julianday('2025-07-01') AS INT) AS pre_days,
 CAST(julianday('2025-09-30')-julianday('2025-09-01') AS INT)+1 AS post_days
FROM workspaces WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'

SELECT
 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status='succeeded' AND payment_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30') AS q2_gross,
 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status='succeeded' AND payment_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30') AS q3_gross,
 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payout_amount),0) FROM referrals WHERE referral_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30') AS q2_payouts,
 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payout_amount),0) FROM referrals WHERE referral_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30') AS q3_payouts,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspaces WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30') AS q2_signups,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspaces WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30') AS q3_signups

onboarding.name: onboarding

revenue_link.metric: monthly-plan workspaces still paying >=55 days after signup, treatment minus control (pp)

evidence.caveat: Randomised in two countries only; Q3 cohort retention also reflects rollout to all other signups.

onboarding.evidence_query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT w.workspace_id, w.signup_date,
         MAX(CASE WHEN julianday(substr(e.event_timestamp,1,10))-julianday(w.signup_date)>=30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained
  FROM workspaces w LEFT JOIN events e USING(workspace_id)
  WHERE w.signup_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-09-30' GROUP BY w.workspace_id)
SELECT x.arm, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.retained) AS retained
FROM experiment x JOIN r USING(workspace_id) GROUP BY x.arm
onboarding.confidence_rule: low: 95% range includes 0; high: range excludes 0 and its half-width is at most half the estimate; medium: range excludes 0 but is wider
